nodes.name: Webhook - Escalation
nodes.notes: High-severity escalation entry. Token from env credential reference. SLA timers + feedback status check via GET /feedback/status (read-only).

nodes.name: Validate Token
nodes.notes: Real shared-secret validation against $env secret. Reject missing/wrong, accept exact. Never log token. No destructive, no autonomous.

nodes.name: Format Escalation
nodes.notes: Formats high-severity escalation. Includes GET status URL for SLA check. No full_log. contain_requested creates an approval-required request; no containment action is executed - human approval only.

nodes.name: Email - L2 Escalation
nodes.notes: Immediate L2 notification for high/critical. Fail-open.

nodes.name: Wait - 15m SLA
nodes.notes: SLA wait 15m for acknowledgement. After wait, check feedback status via GET /feedback/status (read-only). If acknowledged -> no L2 re-escalation. If not -> escalate. Endpoint failure -> fail-safe escalation to L2 (safe documented behavior).

nodes.name: HTTP - Check Ack Status (GET)
nodes.notes: CRITICAL FIX Phase 2B: Read-only GET /api/v1/alerts/{id}/feedback/status to check acknowledgement. NOT POST /feedback (previous misuse). Returns acknowledged bool, has_feedback, latest_verdict, feedback_count, acknowledged_at. Token from env credential $env.N8N_WEBHOOK_TOKEN || $env.N8N_CALLBACK_TOKEN. If endpoint fails, fail-safe to escalation (safe behavior).

nodes.name: Switch - Acknowledged?
nodes.notes: If acknowledged=true (has_feedback with any verdict) -> no L2 escalation. If not acknowledged or endpoint failed (fallback) -> escalate to L2. Fail-safe: endpoint failure results in L2 escalation (documented safe behavior).

parameters.subject: ={{ $json._escalation ? $json._escalation.subject + ' [SLA BREACH - L2]' : '[SOC][SLA BREACH] L2 escalation required' }}
parameters.text: ={{ $json._escalation ? $json._escalation.bodyText + '\n\n*** SLA BREACH: Not acknowledged within 15m - L2 escalation ***' : 'SLA breach - feedback status check failed or not acknowledged, escalating to L2 (fail-safe). Alert: ' + ($json.alert_id || 'unknown') }}

nodes.name: Email - L2 SLA Breach
nodes.notes: L2 escalation on SLA breach or status endpoint failure (fail-safe). No autonomous containment. contain_requested creates an approval-required request; no containment action is executed.

meta.description: Phase 2B high-severity escalation FIXED: real token validation ($env secret exact match), SLA 15m wait, then GET /api/v1/alerts/{id}/feedback/status (read-only) to check acknowledged bool, has_feedback, latest_verdict, count, acknowledged_at. If acknowledged -> no L2 escalation, if not acknowledged -> L2 escalation, if endpoint fails -> fail-safe L2 escalation (safe documented). No secrets, no full_log, no destructive, no autonomous containment, contain_requested creates an approval-required request; no containment action is executed.
